description: List the shipping methods for the current cart with price, ETA and the free-shipping threshold. Today there is one: worldwide tracked shipping, 7–14 business days, free once the cart subtotal reaches free_shipping_from. Use it to answer 'how much / how long is shipping' or to tell the human how much more gets free shipping. Read-only and works on an empty cart too. Prices here are USD for the cart as it is; the final shipping amount, in the destination's currency, is in get_order_preview.
name: get_shipping_options

free_shipping_from.description: Subtotal (USD) at which shipping becomes free.

title: Get shipping options
